authority: Current mandate/risk limits prevail; recommendations do not authorize brokerage execution or automatic closure.
principles: One shared collector per feed; fan out stored records
Provider candidates are alternatives, not a requirement to purchase all
Observation age, update cycle, processing interval and reasoning interval are distinct
Only entitled genuinely live feeds support critical-state price decisions
Existing FA/UW/Form4 and Hal X writer assignments remain until explicitly migrated
Customer/Supplier Event Map is a module inside News Alerts in this five-bot design

provider_candidates: Existing Robinhood path, subject to measured quality
One entitled consolidated equities feed: Databento or Massive
feeds.normal_collection_target: Stream; fallback shared watchlist 1–5 min, Rose-held 15–30 sec, Hal-held underlying 60 sec
feeds.critical_collection_target: Rose critical 5–10 sec; Hal critical 10–30 sec, if provider supports genuinely live data
feeds.freshness_policy: Action targets <=30 sec ordinary / <=10 sec critical; retain applicable current <=120 sec hard gate
feeds.notes: Consolidated quotes and single-venue BBO are different; record scope. Use an actual equity quote rather than ORATS parity-derived stockPrice. Production Tech∪chip equity quotes are not a second Hal writer: Rose solely writes market-data/latest/rh-quotes.json (owner rose, writer refresh_marks.py via dashboard/refresh_marks.py, ttl_seconds 120, 38 Tech∪chip+index symbols). Hal reads that file for soft tape. Elevate/invalidate stays live Robinhood <=120s and is never served from rh-quotes. This feed entry remains a recommendation for a future entitled stream; it does not authorize another Robinhood quote loop.

production_rh_quotes.use: scan and soft tape / wall-distance color

provider_candidates: Same market-data provider as equity quotes; reuse existing MA lineage
feeds.normal_collection_target: Ingest trades/1-min bars; publish completed 5/15/60-min, RTH daily and completed weekly bars
feeds.critical_collection_target: On corrections/halts/splits; no extra LLM scan on unchanged ticks
feeds.freshness_policy: Calendar-aware completeness and delivery-lag policy; no quote-age TTL on completed daily history
feeds.notes: At least 250 valid daily bars for initial SMA200 coverage, with more history for evaluation; request >=60 sessions of 1-min history as a proposed RVOL/research starting point. These are not validation sufficiency guarantees. Databento UTC daily bars require session aggregation; Massive split-adjusted bars are not automatically dividend-adjusted.

provider_candidates: Existing Robinhood path, verify exact quote age
Entitled OPRA through Databento or Massive
feeds.normal_collection_target: Stream held contracts; Rose 15–30 sec fallback, Hal core 5 min; narrow candidate chains 1–5 min
feeds.critical_collection_target: Target held/near-trigger contracts only; Rose 5–10 sec, Hal 10–30 sec when supported; exact quote before decisions
feeds.freshness_policy: Action targets <=30 sec ordinary / <=10 sec critical, with current hard ceiling preserved; background cache is not actionable freshness
feeds.notes: OPRA provides quote/trade evidence, not guaranteed fill prices or native aggressor intent. Archive contemporaneous held/candidate contract quotes for evaluation.

provider_candidates: ORATS live/historical analytics, subject to entitlement
Existing broker Greeks where definition/timestamp are verified
feeds.normal_collection_target: Rose held 1 min and candidate 5 min; Hal core 15 min; full chain on demand/relevant event
feeds.critical_collection_target: Refresh on material price/IV/event change; do not poll faster than provider update cycle
feeds.freshness_policy: Per-field as-of times; OI is not assumed intraday; model values are not executable NBBO
feeds.notes: ORATS stockPrice may be parity-derived. Keep independent actual underlying quote. Live analytics and time-and-sales have different delivery characteristics.

provider_candidates: Existing Unusual Whales feeds
feeds.normal_collection_target: Existing shared notifications/Q5/open/FH; eligible near-wall refresh 1–5 min where supported
feeds.critical_collection_target: Material flow event or eligible setup transition, subject to quota and documented provider cadence
feeds.freshness_policy: Preserve existing 900-sec cache as background context; report actual observation age
feeds.notes: Unknown opening/buyer intent remains unknown. Reposts, vendor aggregates and the underlying prints are related evidence, not independent votes.

provider_candidates: Existing FlashAlpha levels/exposure
feeds.normal_collection_target: Existing hourly wall pulses plus gated Q5/notifications; fresh request on qualifying entry if needed
feeds.critical_collection_target: Material level roll/structure change; no duplicate Hal writer
feeds.freshness_policy: Existing 600-sec wall TTL during applicable market session; hourly pulses alone cannot satisfy it
feeds.notes: Record model provenance; new current-wall gate and original ticket invalidation are separate. Optional fa-soft cache is not established by the page.

provider_candidates: Market-data provider security master/corporate actions
Official exchange/product calendars and OCC adjustment notices
feeds.normal_collection_target: Daily before open; contract listings and actions on provider notification
feeds.critical_collection_target: Intraday listing/adjustment/halt or calendar correction
feeds.freshness_policy: Effective-date-aware versions; newest known relevant action and calendar required
feeds.notes: Do not assume all options have multiplier 100 or the same close time; point-in-time instrument availability prevents look-ahead.

provider_candidates: Authoritative desk paper ledger and risk configuration
feeds.normal_collection_target: On every authorized change; traders reconcile at start of each run
feeds.critical_collection_target: Immediate risk/position revision and accounting exception
feeds.freshness_policy: Monotonic committed revisions/current snapshot; missing state blocks sized entries
feeds.notes: Paper state only. Current paper-open cache NEVER is not proof the ledger is absent. Credit-spread cashflow sign and denominator must be correct.

provider_candidates: SEC EDGAR submissions and original filing/exhibits
feeds.normal_collection_target: Central staggered 60–120-sec market-window polling; 5-min off-hours fallback; provider push when available
feeds.critical_collection_target: Prioritize held/watchlist issuers and confirmed earnings windows; global rate limit/backoff applies
feeds.freshness_policy: Track filing coverage-through, acceptance and receipt; fresh HTTP response is not complete coverage
feeds.notes: Add 8-K/10-Q/10-K/6-K/20-F and exhibits; SEC standardized XBRL does not include every segment/custom fact.

provider_candidates: Issuer IR press releases, earnings materials, official metrics/transcripts
TSMC monthly revenue and hyperscaler disclosures
feeds.normal_collection_target: Push/RSS where available; targeted 2–5-min fallback
feeds.critical_collection_target: 30–60-sec checks around confirmed releases when permitted; backoff after event
feeds.freshness_policy: Publication/receipt latency and expected event coverage; no guarantee from poll interval
feeds.notes: Confirmed issuer facts can be immediately actionable evidence; a forecast/commitment is not realized revenue.

provider_candidates: One licensed estimates provider, e.g. FactSet current estimates plus explicit point-in-time product
feeds.normal_collection_target: Daily snapshot plus vendor updates; freeze last available baseline before earnings
feeds.critical_collection_target: Post-release revisions as distinct records, not rewriting pre-release baseline
feeds.freshness_policy: Vendor product-specific timing; daily PIT product is not assumed intraday consensus
feeds.notes: If absent, surprise is UNKNOWN rather than zero. Compare like-for-like GAAP/adjusted, fiscal periods and currencies.

provider_candidates: Issuer-confirmed company dates
Official BLS/BEA/Census/Fed/EIA calendars
Existing FA calendar as preliminary cross-check
feeds.normal_collection_target: Daily premarket reconciliation and on official changes; held-ticket check each decision
feeds.critical_collection_target: Update on changed/uncertain dates and imminent events
feeds.freshness_policy: Confirmed/estimated/conflicting/unknown separate; missing coverage is not no-event
feeds.notes: Company calendar ownership News; economic calendar ownership Macro; one shared namespace prevents duplicate events.

provider_candidates: Benzinga licensed WebSocket news/earnings/ratings/transcripts
Original issuer/regulatory sources for confirmation
feeds.normal_collection_target: Persistent stream when entitled; normalized ingestion 24/7 within available coverage
feeds.critical_collection_target: Minimum material factual handoff immediately; deeper enrichment follows
feeds.freshness_policy: Measure publication-to-receipt and receipt-to-delivery; retained quiet periods do not prove feed failure
feeds.notes: One connection per vendor stream/key, fan out internally; replay/deduplicate updates/deletes.

provider_candidates: Existing Hal allowlisted X scan until authorized migration
Entitled X filtered stream as proposed shared discovery feed

feeds.critical_collection_target: Prioritize official/credible held-ticker claims; verify high-severity provisional reports promptly
feeds.freshness_policy: Entitlement and actual coverage explicit; social timestamps are not confirmation
feeds.notes: Rose scanner is disabled in current page. Do not claim stream/migration enabled. No posting/DM actions authorized.

provider_candidates: SEC Form4 source and existing UW/EDGAR sweep
feeds.normal_collection_target: Reuse central filing collection; existing premarket/afternoon sweep remains until migration
feeds.critical_collection_target: New held/watchlist filing or material amendment
feeds.freshness_policy: Backtest from filing availability, not transaction date
feeds.notes: Separate purchases/sales from grants/exercises/tax withholding/gifts; delayed disclosure is not live insider buying.

provider_candidates: Evidence from issuer filings/IR/contracts
Optional licensed relationship data such as FactSet Revere, independently verified before use
feeds.normal_collection_target: Update on material evidence; daily active-edge check, weekly wider audit, filing-driven detailed review
feeds.critical_collection_target: Material order/capex/financing/policy event affecting held/watchlist names
feeds.freshness_policy: Verification deadline does not terminate relationship; unreported allocation remains unknown
feeds.notes: One-hop default; two-hop only for meaningful evidenced path. Private AI companies included as entities; distinct project milestones avoid double counting.

provider_candidates: Original BLS/BEA/Census/Fed/EIA release documents
Trading Economics stream for discovery/timeliness where entitled
feeds.normal_collection_target: Release calendar-driven; stream preferred; source-supported 60–120-sec targeted official fallback around scheduled releases
feeds.critical_collection_target: Canonical minimum actual/consensus handoff promptly, then available 1/5/15-min transmission follow-ups
feeds.freshness_policy: Actual source publication/availability governs; no synthetic instant release
feeds.notes: Macro owns canonical actuals/revisions; News links the record. A headline-only release can remain provisional.

provider_candidates: Trading Economics licensed economist consensus or another verified survey provider
feeds.normal_collection_target: Refresh daily and relevant pre-release window; freeze the last available observation before publication
feeds.critical_collection_target: Do not replace frozen consensus with post-release values
feeds.freshness_policy: Point-in-time baseline with own vintage/availability and coverage
feeds.notes: Forecast (survey consensus) and TEForecast (provider model) are different fields.

provider_candidates: Verified licensed cash-Treasury/TIPS yield source
FRED DGS10/DFII10 only for dated daily history
feeds.normal_collection_target: Stream or 30–60-sec live-source observations during relevant sessions
feeds.critical_collection_target: 15–30-sec/stream around releases and material reversals where supported
feeds.freshness_policy: Live versus daily observation explicit; source-specific measured age limits
feeds.notes: Treasury futures price is not a cash yield percentage. Do not estimate a live yield without declared validated conversion.

provider_candidates: CME FedWatch API/fed-funds futures
Official Fed statements, minutes, speeches and decisions
feeds.normal_collection_target: CME intraday product 60-sec updates; official documents on publication; daily calendar check
feeds.critical_collection_target: Decision/release-triggered refresh; no polling above product cadence
feeds.freshness_policy: Market-implied odds versus official policy separate
feeds.notes: CME probabilities are pricing-derived, not the Fed forecast.

provider_candidates: Entitled CME NQ/ES quotes via vendor or CME
feeds.normal_collection_target: Stream or 30–60-sec observations
feeds.critical_collection_target: 15–30-sec/stream around releases where supported
feeds.freshness_policy: Matched time/reference/session across NQ and ES
feeds.notes: QQQ/SPY are separately labeled ETF proxies. Front/back-month and baseline changes can create false relative leadership.

provider_candidates: CME WTI CL and ICE Brent live contracts through an entitled vendor

provider_candidates: Entitled Cboe VIX index and optional VIX futures
Existing broker index quote if provenance verified

feeds.critical_collection_target: Event/shock refresh

provider_candidates: Entitled ICE dollar index/futures or verified FX basket feed

feeds.critical_collection_target: Release/shock refresh when supported

provider_candidates: FRED ICE BofA HY/IG option-adjusted spreads; optional licensed intraday credit tape
feeds.normal_collection_target: Fetch on daily publication; reconcile daily availability
feeds.critical_collection_target: Credit event alert may use separately labeled intraday instrument

feeds.notes: FRED source observations are Percent: preserve raw_value/raw_unit and normalize basis points = raw percent value ×100. Current FRED notes limit these series to three years of history beginning April 2026; older data needs a separately permitted source. ICE data rights require verification before third-party/public-site display. HYG price change is not the same observation as OAS.

provider_candidates: SEC standardized facts plus original filings and issuer metrics

feeds.critical_collection_target: Material restatement/guidance/financing/capex change
feeds.freshness_policy: Newest known vintage; historical facts not overwritten by later restatements
feeds.notes: Expectations and actuals separate. Private project claims require primary evidence rather than invented financials.

provider_candidates: Collector/processor/outbox/consumer telemetry
feeds.normal_collection_target: On observations and heartbeat; health evaluation at least 60 sec during required coverage
feeds.critical_collection_target: Immediate critical held-position coverage loss; ordinary incidents per configured confirmation policy
feeds.freshness_policy: No-event stream is not failed if heartbeat/coverage normal; HTTP success is not complete coverage
